title: Vacancies
subtitle: Track all your vacancies in one place. Paste a vacancy link (from any site — LinkedIn, Djinni, robota.ua, dou.ua, etc.) and the stack fills in itself. In Kanban view, drag cards between statuses, use a card's Move ▾ menu to jump straight to any status, or select a card and press ←/→ — no mouse needed.
